gloss: to report; to inform; to cover (news)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {報|ほう}じていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to report; to inform; to cover (news)
definitions.explanation: To convey news or information, especially through media. A formal word used primarily in journalism and broadcasting.

examples.japanese: ⟦メディア→メディア：11165_media⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{報|ほう}じた。
⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{報|ほう}じて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The newspapers are covering it extensively.

examples.japanese: {各局|かくきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{報|ほう}じたことで、⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Public attention gathered after all the news stations reported on this issue simultaneously.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal verb used primarily in media and journalism contexts. The alternative form {報|ほう}ずる also exists but is less common in modern Japanese. Often seen in passive form: 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{報|ほう}じられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (it is reported that ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{報|ほう}じる (to report an incident)
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{報|ほう}じられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (it is reported that ~)
- ⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{報|ほう}じる (to cover extensively)
- ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{報|ほう}じる (to report simultaneously)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to report (news) — more common as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb
- ⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to convey, to report — broader usage, not limited to media
